retrievalProfile.description: A structured 1960s-style layout featuring bold horizontal stripes, a high-contrast central portrait, and heavy sans-serif typography with offset drop shadows.
triggerTerms: purple and yellow geometric music poster
excludeWhen: organic or fluid shapes are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A graphic composition defined by a grid of horizontal yellow and purple stripes against a white background, featuring a centered, high-contrast monochrome portrait of a man in a suit, flanked by large-scale, shadowed sans-serif text.
coreVisualRelationships: Horizontal stripes create a rhythmic background for the static central figure.
The purple of the subject's suit mirrors the purple stripes and text shadows.
High-contrast yellow accents provide a vibrant counterpoint to the deep purple tones.
Text is integrated into the horizontal bands, creating a unified graphic structure.
coreInvariants: Tri-color palette of purple, yellow, and white
Heavy drop shadows on all display typography

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered in the lower two-thirds of the frame, medium-close-up scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face, framed by the intersection of horizontal lines.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down reading of the large display text, leading to the central portrait, then to the secondary text on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: White horizontal bands provide breathing room between the dense color blocks.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep Royal Purple for text shadows, suit, and primary stripes.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright Lemon Yellow for primary text fill and accent stripes.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White for the background base and negative space bands.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation yellow against low-value, high-saturation purple creates a vibrating visual energy.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to Purple, Yellow, White, and Black/Grayscale for the portrait.

letterConstructionRules: Hard-edged, non-blended drop shadows offset to the bottom right
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A heavy upright sans-serif for the primary name paired with a condensed italic sans-serif for the title.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the weight and grotesque feel of the primary text.
Provides the necessary verticality and weight for the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a graphic background consisting of horizontal stripes in white, yellow, and purple. Place a high-contrast, monochrome (black and white) portrait of a man in a dark suit in the center-bottom, ensuring his shoulders are cut off by the frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply large, bold sans-serif text in the top left with yellow fill and purple drop shadows. Add secondary condensed italic text on the right side with dark gray fill and purple drop shadows.

verificationChecks: Are the horizontal stripes perfectly parallel?
Does the text have a hard-edged purple drop shadow?
Is the portrait high-contrast and monochrome?
Is the color palette strictly limited to purple, yellow, white, and gray?

postGenerationChecks: Check for clean, sharp edges on all geometric shapes.
Ensure the purple shadow color is consistent across all text elements.
Verify the portrait does not contain modern digital artifacts.
Confirm the layout maintains a strong horizontal rhythm.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [bold sans-serif typography] with [hard-edge drop shadows] over a [horizontal striped background] featuring a [centered monochrome portrait].
